tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Lists the market cards of the Arquestra Consulting Market Radar: public consulting contracts in Europe from EUR 15,000 up, one card per country and kind of work (all, strategy, transformation, platform, build_run), with headline figures (awards in 24 months, open calls now, median value, median bids

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One market card (country x kind of work), as rebuilt every week: awards and values of the last 24 months, competition (bids, single-bid share), the top winners by awards and by value, SME share, price weight and award vs estimate, main buyers, trend, the open calls closing first and the contracts co

tools.name: list_firms
tools.description: Lists the consulting firms that win public contracts in Europe and have a firm card (the leading firms of each country), with awards in 24 months, value won, main country and kind of work, and the links to their card and page. Filter by country (firms with awards there), kind, or words of the name.

tools.name: get_firm
tools.description: One firm's public consulting contracts in Europe over 24 months: awards by country, kind of work and buyer type, value won, rank, main buyers, trend, how often it wins alone, bids, frameworks it holds, latest awards with notice links, co-winners and similar firms. Give the slug (from list_firms) or

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Keyword search over the public consulting calls open now and the consulting awards of the last six months in Europe (title, buyer and winners; words match the start of words, accents ignored). Search in English: every title is also indexed in an English translation; add words in the country's langua

tools.name: about
tools.description: What the Arquestra Consulting Market Radar covers and how it is built (sources, value band, window, classification), the date of the data, the licence (CC BY 4.0) and the attribution to give, the limits of this server and where to ask for more.

tools.name: panel_event
tools.description: Internal to the radar's panel (MCP App), hidden from the model: counts which part of the panel the person opened. Returns no data.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_market" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
